messages:
maya (sec): Heads-up - we're seeing a spike of decrypt failures for some customer snapshot restores since 23:00 UTC. Errors look like 'unable to locate CEK pointer' and 'encrypted-header mismatch'. Not widespread but affecting ~7 restores.
liam (encops): yikes. Any commonalities: same bucket, same uploader service account, same KMS key?
maya (sec): all from the same object-store prefix `prod-db-snapshots/tenant-42/` and timestamps line up with a key rotation event at ~22:55 UTC.
adrian (sre): can you paste an example error + object headers?
maya (sec): here's snippet from restore job logs: ```RestorerError: DecryptHeaderFailed: envelope_header_id 0x9f4a not found; rewrap_status=FAILED``` and from `s3 head-object` metadata: `x-amz-meta-encrypted-header: v2|key=f:oldkey-arn|wrap=none`
sam (infra): that metadata looks like it references the older key. Did the rotation perform a header rewrap step? Our rotation job had two phases - rewrap metadata and re-encrypt payload; maybe the metadata job failed for some objects.
liam (encops): this smells like "orphaned header" where CEK pointer kept a reference to the old key material that was retired. Two immediate diagnostics: 1) query audit logs for KeyReEncrypt/RotateKey events around 22:50-23:10 and correlate with object PUT HEAD calls. 2) check if KMS grants were updated for uploader svcacct.
nora (product): impact: customers might not be able to restore a small subset of older snapshots. We need an incident comms skeleton if we escalate.
adrian (sre): running a quick grep in cloudtrail for tenant-42 shows a `ReEncrypt` batch job at 22:57 which returned partial failures. Poking the rotation controller logs now.
liam (encops): short-term mitigation options: a) temporarily re-enable the old CMK for decrypt (if allowed by policy) so restores succeed; b) grant a one-time envelope-rewrap grant to a worker to rewrap headers from old->new key; c) provide a customer-facing workaround to re-upload snapshot after rewrap (last resort). Which is feasible?
sam (infra): legal/policy may forbid re-enabling retired keys. But we do have the ability to create a short-lived KMS grant that allows rewrap if security approves. Need sec approval and audit trail.
maya (sec): I'm +1 on a tightly-scoped, time-limited grant for the rewrap worker. Requirements: audit log entries for every rewrap, least privilege on bucket prefix, and signed runbook.
liam (encops): I'll draft a small rewrap job. Pseudocode: ```python
# rewrap header example
old_key = 'arn:aws:kms:...:old'
new_key = 'arn:aws:kms:...:new'
meta = get_object_metadata(obj)
cek_pointer = parse_encrypted_header(meta['x-amz-meta-encrypted-header'])
plaintext_cek = kms.decrypt(KeyId=old_key, CiphertextBlob=cek_pointer)
new_pointer = kms.encrypt(KeyId=new_key, Plaintext=plaintext_cek)
update_object_metadata(obj, {'x-amz-meta-encrypted-header': format_pointer(new_pointer)})
```
liam (encops): job will run with a dedicated service account and an ephemeral KMS grant permitting Decrypt using old_key and Encrypt using new_key, scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::prod-db-snapshots/tenant-42/*`.
adrian (sre): we should stage-run on a handful of objects and verify restore flow end-to-end. I'll prepare canary test harness.
maya (sec): add these controls before run: pre-run approval in #eng-security, and require `deploy-bot` to produce deploy audit event with manifest. Also log each object rewrap to our audit log with object name, before/after header, operator principal.
sam (infra): quick RBAC check: uploader svcacct lost `kms:Decrypt` on old key because rotation revoked grant. That explains failures. Rewrap job will need explicit grant.
liam (encops): timeline: I'll have a safe rewrap job and grant request ready in ~45m. Adrian will run canary for 10 objects, then escalate to full run if green.
nora (product): please keep me posted, I may need to notify affected customers with ETA.
maya (sec): opened a short incident ticket and added checklist: 1) audit search & list impacted objects 2) prepare rewrap job + manifest 3) request ephemeral grant from KMS with scoping 4) canary rewrap + restore validation 5) full rewrap 6) postmortem (root cause + automation to avoid)
liam (encops): root cause hypothesis: rotation pipeline split-phase where metadata rewrap step didn't reconcile transient failures; need idempotent rewrap and retries with backoff. Will add retry semantics and tombstone detection.
adrian (sre): can confirm rotation controller shows a timeout hitting the metadata rewrap step. I'll add an alert for >1% rewrap failure rate.
maya (sec): ok team — act on the plan, tag me on approvals. If we need to re-enable keys we must route through security with explicit risk statement. :lock:
deploy-bot: triggered deploy request #IR-6489997777 by liam (encops) — waiting for approvals.
maya (sec): noted. once grant is created I want live audit streaming to sec SIEM and a post-run log export.
liam (encops): acknowledged. I'll update thread with grant ARN and canary results.
